doctor.subtitle: Before you register, here's what being a Little Champ partner doctor looks like.

monthly.title: Monthly Meet-Ups
monthly.text: Meet families through two friendly sessions every month — for guidance, check-ins and ongoing support.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Support
whatsapp.text: Parents can message you directly on WhatsApp for quick questions and timely, caring advice.

branch.title: Visit Your Branch
branch.text: Parents and children can visit your branch for warm, face-to-face consultations whenever needed.

playgroup.subtitle: Before you register, here's what joining Little Champ brings to your playgroup.

games.title: Playful Learning
games.text: Little learners explore Maths, reading and craft through joyful, age-appropriate games they love.

updates.title: Parent Updates
updates.text: Parents receive regular progress updates, so every little milestone gets celebrated together.

safe.title: Safe & Guided
safe.text: An ad-free, monitored space with teacher dashboards to gently guide every child through the day.
